name: Dictation
description: System-wide dictation and agent-ask via the Island companion: speak anywhere to type a transcript, or ask an agent and paste the answer into the focused app.

definition.note: On/off switch for system-wide dictation + agent-ask hosted by the Island companion. Enabling this plugin is the single switch — there is no separate settings master toggle. Island registers the global shortcuts and drives capture → Core STT → optional agent → ghost insert. Core-local — no gateway restart.
